name: Screaming Gully
summary: Steam and wind make Screaming Gully howl beneath the northern Barrens, at the Wailing Caverns’ entrance.

sections.title: Threshold of the Nightmare
sections.body: Past the entrance, wind groans through the deep fissures of Screaming Gully. Damp growth and humid mist fill the cavern, far from the dry Barrens above. Lady Anacondra, a Fanglord, watches over the acolytes of the Druids of the Fang and fierce deviate raptors. Ancient snapping turtles patrol the shallow waters below, including Kresh.

faq.q: Where is the Screaming Gully located?
faq.answer: Screaming Gully lies just beyond the portal inside the Wailing Caverns, beneath the northern Barrens.

faq.q: Why is it called the Screaming Gully?
faq.answer: Steam and wind vent through fissures in the rock, making the Wailing Caverns howl and moan. The wide entrance chasm catches the sound and carries its cries.

faq.q: Who rules over the Screaming Gully?
faq.answer: Lady Anacondra, a Fanglord corrupted by the Emerald Nightmare alongside Naralex, oversees the chamber.
Deviate raptors, corrupted Druids of the Fang and aquatic creatures roam the gully. The ancient turtle Kresh wanders its flooded floor.

angles.text: As a Cenarion druid, you find fallen brethren here. They left the path of claw and sky for serpentine corruption.
